items.text: Settings as code, the </> button at the top of Settings. It writes the scene on the stage as one line you can share three ways: copy the code, copy a link to the scene, or download it as a file. Paste a line (or drop a file) back into the box and Apply opens it; Save keeps it in Your scenes with a number (Scene 001, 002…), so a change never overwrites one you already have. Nothing pasted is ever run as code

changed: Everything Current has to tell you speaks from one line at the top, like the update notice. The short passing messages, warnings, "The sound stopped" (Restart the sound, Reset, Report it; it used to be a chip in the corner) and a new error notice (Reload straight back to where you are, Report it, Keep going) all open there; tap it for more, × to close

Depth camera, on the Input shelf and ring, in beta. A 3D camera on this computer (an Orbbec Astra) plays the field: you and your hands, between near and far, push the current away or pull it in, and a movement sweeps it along. Start Astra Web Demo.command on the Mac, then tap depth (in Chrome); it waits and connects by itself. Its ring has near, far, strength, sweep, push or pull, mirror and see. How much moves is a new Auto source, body › motion, so any control can follow it
changed: Tapping the opening screen starts the sound with the field, as in a sister instrument: the scene's own sound if one is waiting, otherwise the ambient bed

fixed: A scene's beat no longer comes on by itself. With the sound turned off or muted a scene brings no beat, and while Autoplay runs a scene's beat only replaces a beat that is already playing: it never joins an ocean or silence. Tapping a scene in the list still brings its sound

changed: The speaker brings ambient sound, not a beat. From silence a tap starts your last ambient bed (a soft sea the first time); a beat, bytebeat or a scene's beat plays only when you choose one. Stopping a beat in the Sound shelf leaves the ambient playing

Surround, for headsets such as Apple Vision Pro: the stage on a curved wall all around you, and a pinch works as a touch. It appears in the tool shelf only where the browser offers it. The room does not show through: Safari on Vision Pro does not allow that to web pages, so it replaces the room. Not yet tried on a headset

Prism, on the mic tab: a bank of resonators tuned to a chord, so the room rings in it. Four presets (Struck Glass, Tuned Street, Prism Arp, Bent Bell), depth, decay, spacing, drift, chord, root and an arpeggio. It is a shared Surface module, so other instruments can load the same one
